-- local/go.mod --
module example.com/ccreadwrite

go 1.27

-- local/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"slices"
	"sort"
	"unsafe"
)

type box struct {
	M map[string]int
	L []int
	A [3]int
	N int
}

type plain struct {
	V []int
	A [3]int
	N int
}

type row struct {
	V []int
	N int
}

const cfg = box{M: map[string]int{"a": 1}, L: []int{3, 2, 1}, A: [3]int{4, 5, 6}, N: 7}

const items = []box{
	{M: map[string]int{"a": 1}, L: []int{1, 2}, A: [3]int{1, 1, 1}, N: 1},
	{M: map[string]int{"a": 5}, L: []int{10, 20}, A: [3]int{2, 2, 2}, N: 2},
}

const pl = plain{V: []int{3, 2, 1}, A: [3]int{4, 5, 6}, N: 7}

const rows = []row{{V: []int{1, 2}, N: 1}, {V: []int{10, 20}, N: 2}}

const grid = [][]int{{1, 2}, {3, 4}}

const lookup = map[string][]int{"a": {5, 6}, "b": {7, 8}}

func bump(s []int) { s[0] = 70 }

func varCopy() int {
	l := cfg.L
	l[0] = 70
	return 0
}

func elementField() int {
	l := items[1].L
	l[0] = 70
	return 0
}

func variableIndex() int {
	i := 1
	l := items[i].L
	l[0] = 70
	return 0
}

func resliceAppend() int {
	s := cfg.L[:1]
	s = append(s, 70)
	return len(s) - 2
}

func writerCall() int {
	bump(cfg.L)
	return 0
}

func sortCall() int {
	sort.Ints(cfg.L)
	return 0
}

func unsafeWrite() int {
	p := unsafe.SliceData(cfg.L)
	*p = 70
	return 0
}

func copyInto() int {
	l := cfg.L
	copy(l, []int{70, 70, 70})
	return 0
}

func clearVar() int {
	l := cfg.L
	clear(l)
	return 0
}

func reverseVar() int {
	l := cfg.L
	slices.Reverse(l)
	return 0
}

func threeIndex() int {
	l := cfg.L[0:2:2]
	l[0] = 70
	return 0
}

func reflectSet() int {
	reflect.ValueOf(cfg.L).Index(0).SetInt(70)
	return 0
}

func boxed() int {
	var x any = cfg.L
	x.([]int)[0] = 70
	return 0
}

func rangeRows() int {
	for _, r := range rows {
		r.V[0] = 70
	}
	return 0
}

func rowCopy() int {
	r := rows[1]
	r.V[0] = 70
	return 0
}

func rowSlice() int {
	s := rows[1:]
	s[0].V[0] = 70
	return 0
}

func innerSlice() int {
	r := grid[0]
	r[0] = 70
	return 0
}

func outerSlice() int {
	g := grid
	g[0] = []int{70}
	return 0
}

func plainWhole() int {
	p := &pl
	p.V[0] = 70
	return 0
}

func rangeElement() int {
	for _, e := range items {
		e.L[0] = 70
	}
	return 0
}

func structCopy() int {
	c := cfg
	c.L[0] = 70
	return 0
}

func elementCopy() int {
	e := items[1]
	e.L[0] = 70
	return 0
}

func mapCopy() int {
	m := cfg.M
	m["z"] = 1
	return 0
}

func arrayCopy() int {
	a := cfg.A
	a[0] = 99
	return 0
}

func whole() int {
	p := &cfg
	p.L[0] = 70
	return 0
}

func arrayPointer() int {
	p := &cfg.A
	p[0] = 70
	return 0
}

func plainArrayPointer() int {
	p := &pl.A
	p[0] = 71
	return 0
}

func mapValue() int {
	v, _ := lookup["a"]
	v[0] = 70
	return 0
}

func funcMapBearing() int {
	const c = box{M: map[string]int{"a": 1}, L: []int{5, 6, 7}, N: 1}
	l := c.L
	l[0] = 70
	return c.L[0] - 5
}

func funcArrayCopy() int {
	const a = [3]int{5, 6, 7}
	b := a
	b[0] = 70
	return a[0] - 5
}

func funcAddress() int {
	const c = plain{V: []int{5, 6, 7}, A: [3]int{1, 2, 3}, N: 1}
	p := &c
	q := &c.A
	r := &c.N
	p.N = 70
	q[0] = 71
	*r = 72
	return c.N - 1 + c.A[0] - 1
}

func control() int { return 0 }

var cases = map[string]func() int{
	"var-copy":          varCopy,
	"element-field":     elementField,
	"variable-index":    variableIndex,
	"reslice-append":    resliceAppend,
	"writer-call":       writerCall,
	"sort":              sortCall,
	"unsafe":            unsafeWrite,
	"copy-into":         copyInto,
	"clear-var":         clearVar,
	"reverse-var":       reverseVar,
	"three-index":       threeIndex,
	"reflect-set":       reflectSet,
	"boxed":             boxed,
	"range-rows":        rangeRows,
	"row-copy":          rowCopy,
	"row-slice":         rowSlice,
	"inner-slice":       innerSlice,
	"outer-slice":       outerSlice,
	"plain-whole":       plainWhole,
	"range-element":     rangeElement,
	"struct-copy":       structCopy,
	"element-copy":      elementCopy,
	"map-copy":          mapCopy,
	"array-copy":        arrayCopy,
	"whole":             whole,
	"array-pointer":     arrayPointer,
	"plain-array-pointer": plainArrayPointer,
	"map-value":         mapValue,
	"func-map-bearing":  funcMapBearing,
	"func-array-copy":   funcArrayCopy,
	"func-address":      funcAddress,
	"control":           control,
}

func drift() int {
	a, _ := lookup["a"]
	d := cfg.L[0] - 3 + items[1].L[0] - 10 + len(cfg.M) - 1 + cfg.A[0] - 4
	d += pl.V[0] - 3 + pl.A[0] - 4 + rows[0].V[0] - 1 + rows[1].N - 2
	d += grid[0][0] - 1 + len(grid[0]) - 2 + a[0] - 5
	return d
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("before")
	run, ok := cases[os.Args[1]]
	if !ok {
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	delta := run()
	fmt.Println("after", drift()+delta)
}

-- imported/go.mod --
module example.com/ccreadwriteimp

go 1.27

-- imported/lib/go.mod --
module example.com/ccrwlib

go 1.27

-- imported/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type Box struct {
	M map[string]int
	L []int
	A [3]int
	N int
}

type Plain struct {
	L []int
	N int
}

const C = Box{M: map[string]int{"a": 1}, L: []int{3, 2, 1}, A: [3]int{4, 5, 6}, N: 7}

const Items = []Box{
	{M: map[string]int{"a": 1}, L: []int{1, 2}, A: [3]int{1, 1, 1}, N: 1},
	{M: map[string]int{"a": 5}, L: []int{10, 20}, A: [3]int{2, 2, 2}, N: 2},
}

const P = Plain{L: []int{3, 2, 1}, N: 7}

const Ints = []int{9, 8, 7}

-- imported/app/go.mod --
module example.com/ccrwapp

go 1.27

require example.com/ccrwlib v0.0.0

replace example.com/ccrwlib => ../lib

-- imported/app/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"example.com/ccrwlib"
)

func varCopy() int {
	l := lib.C.L
	l[0] = 70
	return 0
}

func elementField() int {
	l := lib.Items[1].L
	l[0] = 70
	return 0
}

func variableIndex() int {
	i := 1
	l := lib.Items[i].L
	l[0] = 70
	return 0
}

func wholeCopy() int {
	c := lib.C
	c.L[0] = 70
	return 0
}

func plainField() int {
	l := lib.P.L
	l[0] = 70
	return 0
}

func plainSlice() int {
	l := lib.Ints
	l[0] = 70
	return 0
}

func control() int { return 0 }

var cases = map[string]func() int{
	"var-copy":       varCopy,
	"element-field":  elementField,
	"variable-index": variableIndex,
	"whole-copy":     wholeCopy,
	"plain-field":    plainField,
	"plain-slice":    plainSlice,
	"control":        control,
}

func drift() int {
	return lib.C.L[0] - 3 + lib.Items[1].L[0] - 10 + lib.P.L[0] - 3 + lib.Ints[0] - 9
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("before")
	run, ok := cases[os.Args[1]]
	if !ok {
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	delta := run()
	fmt.Println("after", drift()+delta)
}
